notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Gamepad controls added and updated.
notes.content:
To improve the gamepad experience, I’ve added new control options and changed the menu button.
Keyboard controls remain the same.

New gamepad inputs:

[list]
[*] Left hand: Left stick, D-Pad
[*] Right hand: Right stick, right-side buttons (XYAB / ⚪︎△□×)
[*] Open menu: Start button(XBox:Menu/Switch:+/DualShock:Option)
[/list]

Stick controls still work as before.
Added button-only input for players who prefer not to use sticks.

Feel free to share your impressions on the community board or X!
Keep improving based on your feedback.

Enjoy the brain-bending experience!

notes.title: Major Update! Hard Mode Added!
notes.content:
"Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands Major Update Released!
I'm thrilled that so many of you have been enjoying the game.
As a token of our gratitude, we’ve added exciting new features: Hard Mode and new characters.

Here are the updates:

[list]
[*] Added Hard Mode.
[*] Introduced new characters: Bright the Clown and Leftia the Maid.
[*] Added achievements for Hard Mode.
[*] Fixed the behavior of snow.
[*] Corrected typographical errors.
[*] Added a button on the title screen to link to the rankings.
[/list]

Since the new features are quite challenging, I plan to adjust them based on your feedback.

Thank you for playing!
Take on Hard Mode at your own pace, and enjoy the challenge.

I appreciate your continued support for "Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands"!

notes.title: Planning to add new characters and a new floor to the game.
notes.content:
Hello!
Have you played "Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands"?
Thank you to those who have played it! If you haven't yet, please give it a try.

I'm happy to see that many players are experiencing the "brain glitch" moments the game offers.
It seems you're enjoying the sense of achievement and liberation as you push through the frustration and stress.

Interestingly, we've received feedback requesting even more challenging floors.
In response, we plan to add two new features:

[list]
[*] A new duo of characters with precise and tricky controls: Bright the Clown and Leftia the Maid
[*] A challenging new floor: NESW, cardinal directions
[/list]

We’ll decide whether to release these updates simultaneously or separately, depending on our progress. Stay tuned!

Thank you for your continued support of "Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands"!

notes.title: "Hypothesis on the Symmetry of Vision and Hands" Early Access Begins!
notes.content:
If you're reading this, it means you're interested—thank you so much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949109/ed643b62de10b86ba8bc0e935cace03abae5e000.gif[/img]

This is a simple action game where your brain might glitch as you control the right and left hands independently.

Here are the key features as intended by the developer:
[list]
[*] Control the right hand with your right hand and the left hand with your left hand—prepare for your brain to glitch as you lose track of left and right.
[*] If your brain doesn't glitch, you can complete the game in about an hour.
[*] Aim for top scores and rankings in time attack mode.
[/list]

We showcased the game at Comiket, Japan's largest doujin event, and received great feedback.
This is a project we're confident in, so please give it a try!
